command: uv run python scripts/measure_slm_slots.py --grounding-accuracy --arm local --limit 20 --no-pii --corpus-dir corpus --out results/grounding-accuracy-local.json
benchmark_input: corpus assembled inside CI from the repository's tracked fixtures: 96 clause units from 17 documents (tests/fixtures/**/*.txt verbatim plus fixture PDFs/DOCX parsed with openreview_cli.parsing)
notes: CI run 36827583980, job grounding-accuracy; artifact grounding-accuracy-local.json. The immediately preceding run of the same code (b0f691b) caught 28 of 40, so treat the caught count as 27-28 of 40 at this sample size. Positives are verbatim sentences from the cited clause as sent to the model, so they are trivially grounded and the negative arm is the signal; no real-world false-positive rate may be quoted. Ran with --no-pii because CI has no spaCy model: raw clause text was sent to a local model only. Single-sample smoke measurement on a 2-vCPU GitHub-hosted runner, so latencies are CPU-bound and machine-specific. unreadable_answers counts answers the reader could not parse, which is how a reader defect was separated from model hesitation.
